posts.title: Safety training goes digital at ROCKWOOL
posts.summary: D-TECH delivered a Safety Training Kiosk, a Group Training Kiosk and a customised work-permit module at ROCKWOOL. The video walks through how induction, biometric verification and safety-pass printing work on the shop floor.

posts.title: D-TECH and JIVA: automation that industries rely on
posts.summary: An introduction to the JIVA partnership: engineering services, system integration, turnkey automation, special-purpose machines and heavy lifting equipment.
